biography_english:
A Walister who once captained the Knights of Almorica. He served as the right hand of Duke Ronwey, and was a vital member of the Resistance. His mother was killed by the Galgastani.
  He died in a skirmish with {hero} at Coritanae Keep.
biography_spanish:
Un walister que fue capitan de los caballeros de Almorica. Fue la mano derecha del duque Ronwey y vital miembro de la Resistencia. Su madre fue asesinada por los galgastani.        
  Murio en escaramuza con {hero} en fuerte Coritanae.

biography_english:
A Walister who serves with the Knights of Almorica.
  She is next in command to Sir Leonar, and has been a close supporter of Duke Ronwey. Though known for her calm demeanor, she stubbornly opposes the use of underhanded tactics.
biography_spanish:
Walister al servicio de los caballeros de Almorica.
  Es la segunda al mando tras sir Leonar y fiel partidaria del duque Ronwey. Aunque se le conoce por su calma, se opone con firmeza a las tacticas sucias.

biography_english:
A Walister who serves with the Knights of Almorica.
  She is next in command to Sir Leonar, and has been a close supporter of Duke Ronwey. Though known for her calm demeanor, she stubbornly opposes the use of underhanded tactics.
  She is currently en route to Balmamusa with {hero}, tasked with inciting the Walister there to revolt.
biography_spanish:
Walister al servicio de los caballeros de Almorica.

  Va de camino a Balmamusa con {hero}, con la mision de incitar a los walister a la revuelta.

biography_english:
A Walister who once served with the Knights of Almorica. She was of mixed blood, the child of a Walister father and a Galgastani mother. Her conflicting origins did not dull her ambition, and she became a close confidant of Duke Ronwey, second only to Sir Leonar in rank.
  She faced off with {hero} after strongly opposing the Duke's plan to massacre civilians at Balmamusa. She was slain in the battle that ensued.
biography_spanish:
Una walister que sirvio con los caballeros de Almorica. Era de sangre mixta, hija de padre walister y madre galgastani. Sus origenes opuestos no apagaron su ambicion y se volvio confidente cercana del duque Ronwey, segunda tras sir Leonar.                                
  Se enfrento a {hero} tras oponerse con firmeza al plan del duque de masacrar civiles en Balmamusa. Fue asesinada en la batalla.

biography_english:
A Walister who once served with the Knights of Almorica. She was of mixed blood, the child of a Walister father and a Galgastani mother. Her conflicting origins did not dull her ambition, and she became a close confidant of Duke Ronwey, second only to Sir Leonar in rank.
  She faced off with Leonar after strongly opposing the Duke's plan to massacre civilians at Balmamusa. Struck by a crossbow bolt, she succumbed to her wounds a few days after the slaughter.

Una walister que sirvio con los caballeros de Almorica. Era de sangre mixta, hija de padre walister y madre galgastani. Sus origenes opuestos no apagaron su ambicion y se volvio confidente cercana del duque Ronwey, segunda tras sir Leonar.                                
  Se enfrento a Leonar tras oponerse al plan del duque de masacrar civiles en Balmamusa. Impactada por un dardo de ballesta, murio dias despues de la matanza.

biography_english:
A Walister who once served with the Knights of Almorica. She is of mixed blood, the child of a Walister father and a Galgastani mother. She was next in command to Sir Leonar, and was a close supporter of Duke Ronwey.
  She turned her back on the Resistance after opposing the massacre of civilians at Balmamusa. She then fled to Galgastan to be with her mother. Though at first harbored by nobles opposing the Hierophant, she later fell into the hands of the Galgastani army.
  She was rescued by {hero} while being escorted to Coritanae Keep for trial. She turned down his offer to rejoin the Resistance, and has not been heard from since.
biography_spanish:
Una walister que sirvio con los caballeros de Almorica. Hija de padre walister y madre galgastani, de sangre mixta. Fue segunda de sir Leonar y cercana aliada del duque Ronwey.                                        
  Dio la espalda a la resistencia tras oponerse a la masacre de civiles en Balmamusa. Escapo a Galgastan con su madre. Nobles contra el Hierofanta la acogieron al inicio, pero cayo en manos del ejercito galgastani.                                            
  Fue rescatada por {hero} mientras la escoltaban a fuerte Coritanae para juicio. Rechazo su oferta de volver a la resistencia y nada se supo de ella.

biography_english:
A Walister who once served with the Knights of Almorica. She is of mixed blood, the child of a Walister father and a Galgastani mother. She was next in command to Sir Leonar, and was a close supporter of Duke Ronwey.
  She turned her back on the Resistance after opposing the massacre of civilians at Balmamusa. She then fled to Galgastan to be with her mother. There she worked with enemies of the Hierophant to incite revolution in Galgastan.
  {hero} helped her repel Galgastani forces that pursued her after she freed the Lord of Coritanae. Seeing the true nature of the war, she returned to the Resistance to help {hero} put an end to it.

  {hero} dio ayuda para repeler tropas galgastani tras liberar al lider de Coritanae. Al ver la guerra, retorno a la resistencia para ayudar a {hero} a poner fin a la lucha.

biography_english: A lover of ale and women, given to a life of debauchery. Behind his blithe demeanor is a fierce fighter daunting to even the burliest brute. His prowess with the sword is almost unmatched.
biography_spanish: Amante de cerveza y mujeres, dado a la mala vida. Tras su aire alegre hay un fiero guerrero que asusta al mas bruto. Su destreza con la espada casi no tiene rival.

biography_english:
A legendary Galgastani pirate. In his younger days he was known to all who sailed the coastal waters of Valeria. He was greatly feared for the abandon with which he snatched away both cargo and lives. Then one day he took to the shore and disappeared.
  He is also known to have returned unscathed from the Pirate's Graveyard, a place that has claimed the lives of countless sailors.
biography_spanish:
Legendario pirata galgastani. De joven lo conocian todos los que navegaban las aguas de Valeria. Temido por el descaro con que robaba carga y vidas. Un dia desembarco y desaparecio.
  Tambien se sabe que regreso ileso del Cementerio de Piratas, un lugar que ha cobrado la vida de incontables marineros.

biography_english:
A legendary Galgastani pirate. In his younger days, he was known to all who sailed the coastal waters of Valeria, and his name struck fear into their hearts. Said to have returned unscathed from the deadly Pirate's Graveyard.
  After his daughter was slain in battle, he put his plundering days behind him. He went on to lead a life of debauchery at Port Omish, until the ravages of war compelled him to take up his blade once more.
biography_spanish:
Legendario pirata galgastani. De joven lo conocian todos los que navegaban las aguas de Valeria y su nombre causaba terror. Se dice que regreso ileso del peligroso Cementerio de Piratas.
  Tras la muerte de su hija en batalla, dejo la pirateria. Paso a llevar una vida de excesos en Puerto Omish, hasta que la guerra lo obligo a tomar la espada otra vez.

A legendary Galgastani pirate. In his younger days he was known to all who sailed the coastal waters of Valeria. He was greatly feared for the abandon with which he snatched away both cargo and lives.
